name: Straight LED strip
notes: A parametric straight strip of WS2812B pixels. A placement sets its dims: pixels, length and pitch in meters. The pitch defaults to length / pixels, so the pixels sit centred on the strip with the end pixels half a pitch in from each end. Pixel 0 is at end_a; aim the strip from its data input toward its far end.

tape_w.src: a common 10 mm tape; modeling placeholder, not measured
